covered.2: The code R91.8 may be used when a patient has multiple lung nodules with a single nodule of concern. To indicate that R91.8 is being used for this purpose, use the KX modifier following the CPT code. The use of this modifier indicates an attestation that the patient has multiple lung nodules with a single nodule of concern for malignancy. If the code R91.8 is being used to describe another (non-covered) diagnosis, use the appropriate modifier to indicate that the service is non-covered as not reasonable and necessary.
